info.name: SubDub Subscription Tracker API
info.description: Requests mirror the currently implemented Express routes. Some endpoints are intentionally incomplete or have known behavior documented in docs/API_DOCUMENTATION.md. Use disposable local data only.

exec: pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns welcome text', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('welcome to subscription tracker api!'); });

item.name: Sign up (returns a user document; do not use real credentials)

request.description: Creates a user and stores the returned JWT. Current implementation also returns the user document including its password hash; use disposable test data.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('email')) pm.environment.set('email', 'postman-' + pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}') + '@example.com');
if (!pm.environment.get('password')) pm.environment.set('password', 'ReplaceThis123!');
pm.test('returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('includes success, token, and user', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.be.an('object'); });
if (body.data && body.data.token) pm.environment.set('token', body.data.token);
if (body.data && body.data.user) pm.environment.set('userId', body.data.user._id || body.data.user.id || '');

request.description: Set email/password to an existing disposable account. Successful login stores the JWT and userId in the active environment.

exec: pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('includes a token and safe user fields', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.data.user).not.to.have.property('password'); });
if (body.data && body.data.token) pm.environment.set('token', body.data.token);
if (body.data && body.data.user) pm.environment.set('userId', body.data.user.id || '');
pm.test('returns 401 for invalid credentials', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('returns the standard failure shape', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.error).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Users (known exposure and placeholders)
item.description: GET /users is unauthenticated and currently returns password hashes. Do not call it against real data.

request.description: Confirmed security finding: currently returns full user documents, including password hashes.

exec: pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns a data array', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: Get user by ID (requires token; ownership is not enforced)

request.description: Returns a user without password; current implementation does not restrict lookup to the token owner.

exec: pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns a user without password', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.data).not.to.have.property('password'); });

request.description: Creates a subscription and triggers QStash. Requires MongoDB, QSTASH_URL/QSTASH_TOKEN, SERVER_URL, and a reachable QStash endpoint. If QStash fails, the DB record may still have been created.

exec: pm.test('returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('includes subscription and workflow run ID', function () { pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.workflowRunId).to.be.a('string'); });
if (body.data && body.data._id) pm.environment.set('subscriptionId', body.data._id);
pm.test('returns 401 without bearer token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('includes count and subscription data', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.count).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns a subscription', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('returns the updated subscription', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(body.message).to.include('successfully'); });

request.description: Mutates the test subscription. Use disposable local data.

exec: pm.test('returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns cancelled subscription', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.eql('cancelled'); });
pm.test('returns 200 for the authenticated owner', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('returns a subscription array', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('returns the standard failure shape', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.error).to.be.a('string'); });
